banner: INFORMATION ONLY — NOT LEGAL ADVICE. Split and payment facts shown here come from CWI's own records only. A production credit is not a rights-holder record, and an unverified split can never be settled here. For anything you intend to rely on, contact CWI Business Affairs at hp@cumulativeweb.com — a licensed attorney executes.

contact.name: CWI Business Affairs
contact.role: Prepares checklists and tracks rights documents. Does NOT draft legal language, file, sign, or certify rights — a licensed attorney and Black execute.

ethics: Information only. Never legal advice. Every answer hands off to CWI Business Affairs. Unverifiable questions fail closed — no split percentage is ever guessed.

items: Writer / publishing splits — no signed split sheets are on file for ANY CWI track. Split percentages cannot be stated.
PRO affiliation (ASCAP / BMI / SESAC) — unknown for all works; no publisher IDs or work registration numbers on file.
ISRC inventory — only some tracks carry distributor-verified ISRCs; public-source conflicts are unresolved and several tracks have none.
Master-control documentation — no chain-of-title showing CWI/Black controls the masters is on file.
Sample clearance status — no clearance letters and no sworn no-sample attestations on file for any track.

royalty_path: Email CWI Business Affairs at hp@cumulativeweb.com — state the track, the party you represent, and whether your question concerns the master side, the publishing side, or both.

Business Affairs prepares a checklist of the documents needed (signed split sheets, PRO affiliations, publisher/work registration numbers, master-control docs). They do not draft legal language or certify rights.
Writer splits are documented in signed split sheets by the rights holders, executed by a licensed attorney.
Do not rely on any payment figure until written split documentation is in hand.
